5.45.spotlight_verdict: An interesting race in which the vote goes to the resurgent EDGEWELL who has won at Hereford in his last two runs and remains well handicapped on his best form. The progressive Ballynaheer has won four of his last seven starts and he's feared most ahead of Sweet Nightingale, who ran better than the bare facts behind two improvers at Plumpton last time. Four-time chase winner Gold Clermont is also in the mix after her creditable effort over hurdles here last month.[David Moon]

Gold Clermont 10 11-12p Andy Irvine Chad Bament (7) 7-1 105 105 114 All four wins have came over fences Andy Irvine; her last success was in January 2024 but that was at this track (3m3f) and she returned to form with a creditable third over hurdles here (3m2f, soft) last month; that was only her second start since rejoining her former stable and she's in the mix back over fences. Le Galli Bier 5 11-7tp G & J Moore Freddie Mitchell (3) 8-1 102 92 113 Respectable effort from out of the weights in a higher grade here (2m3f, good to soft) last month but overall record is now 0-13 and he has stamina to prove at this new trip; others are more persuasive. Moonlit Potter 8 11-4b Dr R Newland & J Insole Charlie Hammond 7-1 97 98 111 Winning hurdler for Henry Daly in 2024 but she's been generally disappointing over fences and unseated at the seventh when front-running at Hereford last week; on dangerous mark but she's now 0-9 in this sphere and others are more convincing. Carrigmoorna Rowan 9 11-3 R Potter James Davies 8-1 96 111 114 Became disappointing for Harry Fry; competitive form over hurdles and fences for current yard but he bled three runs back and couldn't hang in there at Exeter (2m3f, good) last time; continues to drop down the weights but he's now 0-8 over fences and is untried at this trip. Edgewell 8 10-12p N Scholfield Harry Reed 100-30 91 99 112 8yo who has been resurgent with wins at Hereford (3m1f, good) in his last two starts; 3lb higher than last time but he stayed on strongly to beat a clear second and remains well handicapped on his best form; key player. Sweet Nightingale 9 10-9t Polly Gundry Charlie Deutsch 3-1 88 102 115 Made the breakthrough over fences with 10l win at Exeter (3m, good) last month; was beaten by 10l when third of four at Plumpton (3m2f) last time but that was behind two progressive 6yos and her jockey went for home a circuit too soon; still has potential as a staying chaser and she's in the mix off same mark as last time.

horses.spotlight_comment: Lighting Handicap Hurdle £7,700 Total Race Value SKY 2m51/2f For 4yo+ Rated 0-120 (also open to such horses rated 121 and 122 - see Standard Conditions) Minimum weight 10-2 Penalties after April 11th, each hurdle won 7lb Penalty value 1st £4,066.37 2nd £1,871.10 3rd £935.55 4th £468.16 5th £233.31 GD-SFT Trainer Jockey SP OR TS RPR Yellow Star 6 11-6p G & J Moore Caoilin Quinn 16-1 118 96 128 Bounced back with a win at Warwick (2m5f, good to soft) in December but he was tailed off in next two starts and he didn't get very far at Newbury (fell at third) last time; has plenty to prove again and he's still 3lb higher than for his last win. Precious Metal 5 11-4 Henrietta Knight Ben Jones 6-1 116 96 124 Bumper and maiden hurdle winner; pulled up in a Sandown handicap (2m4f, soft) last month but that was a tough assignment in a valuable event and he still has potential after only five runs in this sphere; needs checking in market on this drop back in grade. He's A Latchico 8 11-4 G & J Moore Tom Queally 11-2 116 106 126 Four-time hurdle winner who has form figures of 11631 at Fontwell; has mixed record this season but he went close at Plumpton (2m4f, soft) on his penultimate run and was rallying in a close fifth when he unseated two out at Kempton (2m, good) last time; one of two runners for the yard and he's an interesting contender back at this track. Valadon 6 11-3t H Fry Bryan Carver 7-2 115 103 126 Scored with a tongue-tie added at Plumpton (2m4f, good to soft) last month and he ran to a similar level when a 2l third at Wincanton (2m4f, good) last time; has been as good as ever in those last two runs and he won this race last year; respected. Calvino 6 11-3 P Nicholls Paddy Hanlon (5) 5-1 115 119 128 Fast-ground bumper winner who landed a Taunton novice (2m3f, good) in January but he was disappointing on his return visit the following month; bit to prove after that but he's still lightly raced and it wouldn't be a surprise if he resumed his progress on handicap debut. Jackomy 6 11-2 N Mulholland Conor O'Farrell 11-8 114 113 127 Lightly raced 6yo who justified favouritism in a Wincanton handicap (2m4f, good) last month and followed up with a dominant display at Ludlow (2m5f, good); up another 10lb but his form has really taken off recently and he's open to more progress; big player.

6.50.betting_forecast: 7/4 West Orchard, 9/2 Amalfi Skyline, Has Troke, 6/1 Counteract, 8/1 Fravanco, 10/1 Approaching Storm, 12/1 Shesupincourt,
6.50.spotlight_verdict: Few of these are rock solid, to put it charitably, with West Orchard (second choice) almost getting a default vote. However, it's worth giving AMALFI SKYLINE the chance to build on his second run back from a big absence, when he hinted some talent remains despite finishing last at this track 41 days ago. Has Troke's body of work makes him eligible for a mention, while market interest in the remainder, notably long-absent veteran Counteract, might be worth heeding.[Richard Russell]
